ftdMode -- Allowed values are {routed|transparent}

healthStatus -- Allowed values are {disabled|green|yellow|red|recovered|error|failed}

deploymentStatus -- Allowed values are {DEPLOYED|DEPLOYMENT_IN_PROGRESS|DEPLOYMENT_PENDING}

license_caps -- Allowed values are {ESSENTIALS|MALWARE_DEFENSE|IPS|URL|SECURE_CLIENT_PREMIER|SECURE_CLIENT_PREMIER_ADVANTAGE|SECURE_CLIENT_VPNOnly}

Flag to replicate inspection mode from Snort 3 version to Snort 2 version.

This is a query parameter. Based on this value, the rule recommendation configuration is set against Snort3 Intrusion Policy.
GENERATE - Generates the rule recommendation for the given recommendedSecurityLevel value and network objects per Snort3 Intrusion Policy.
GENERATE_AND_ACCEPT - Generates the rule recommendation for the given recommendedSecurityLevel value and network objects per Snort3 Intrusion Policy and accepts it against the Snort3 Intrusion Policy.
REFRESH - Refreshes the rule recommendation for already given recommendedSecurityLevel value and network objects per Snort3 Intrusion Policy.
REMOVE - Removes all rule recommendations and ruleRecommendation config per Snort3 Intrusion Policy.
ACCEPT - Accepts the rule recommendation for which rule recommendation is already generated for the given recommendedSecurityLevel value and network objects against the given Snort3 Intrusion Policy
(Required) Domain UUID
(Required) Identifier of the Snort3 intrusion policy.
UUID of the ticket for tracking the configuration changes.
